note: Folder-to-spec map for scripts/check-docs-stale.py (plan row 1b). A change under a rule's globs changes ANY ONE of its specs, or a commit carries `No-Doc-Change: <reason>`. Globs follow .agents/skill-paths.json. A code folder maps to the specs that define its capabilities or name the folder (each rule's note cites the section); proto folders map to the specs whose header names that package. Specs only, never ADRs, which are not edited. A folder stays in unmapped only when no spec defines it.
